meta.title: VOYARA AI — Travel Operating System
meta.description: Personalised travel operations with accountable human control.

common.notEnabled: This operation is not enabled yet.

landing.eyebrow: Human-controlled travel operating system for Azerbaijan
landing.title: A clear path from a travel idea to a verified outcome.
landing.lead: VOYARA AI researches, compares and drafts. Authorised people approve commercial terms, Payments and Bookings.
landing.priceNote: Only approved prices are shown. Unapproved benefits are not published.
landing.screensLead: The existing visual direction is retained. Each screen becomes actionable only when its server authority is ready.
landing.authorityBody: VOYARA AI researches your journey and prepares the proposals. Sensitive decisions — prices, payments and bookings — are always reviewed and approved by a qualified specialist. You receive a clear, personal outcome.
landing.journeyEyebrow: One story — from request to repeat journey
landing.statApproval: Every proposal is approved by a human
landing.footerTagline: AI prepares · A human approves · VOYARA executes
landing.demoLead: Demo views of the eight principal screens. This section exists for product demonstration.
landing.showcaseLead: Each screen shows a live interface state based on the real component.
why: AI researches and prepares itineraries around your requests.
Risk-sensitive decisions are reviewed by a specialist.
Transparent proposals and a precise acceptance flow.
Payment and booking steps progress in sequence, verified.
A single hub for confirmed travel: itinerary, documents, support.
Exceptions and questions are handled by a real specialist.
landing.founderBio: 15 years of travel-industry experience and the MIT Professional Education credential “No-Code AI and Machine Learning: Building Data Science Solutions.” VOYARA is built as a human-controlled travel operating system.
landing.scopeLead: One platform covering the full travel service scope — every step under human control.

planNotes.premium: Full concierge level and priority support
planNotes.black: Highest service priority and individual attention
planNotes.starter: Core corporate workflow for small teams
planNotes.professional: Priority support and deeper reporting readiness

landing.corporateBody: VOYARA manages corporate travel at the team level: employee travel coordination, approval workflows, and policy-aware handling. Every payment and booking step proceeds only after human review.
ctaSteps: No booking or payment happens automatically

auth.passwordToggleToSignIn: Already have an account? Sign in
auth.passwordTooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters.
auth.passwordAccountCreated: Account created. Check your email to confirm.

mfa.title: Second verification step
mfa.body: The operations area requires a second factor from an authenticator app.
mfa.enrollBody: Link the authenticator app on your phone to your VOYARA AI account.
mfa.scanCode: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app.
mfa.challengeBody: Enter the current code from the app to access the operations area.
mfa.complete: Second-factor verification is complete. This session now has elevated assurance.
mfa.genericError: Verification was not completed. Refresh the page and try again.

staffActivation.title: Activate your staff invitation
staffActivation.body: The invitation session is being verified. Second-factor setup follows activation.

founderAccess.title: Access and Role control
founderAccess.body: Staff invitations and Role changes require a high-assurance Founder session and are written to immutable history.
founderAccess.linkBody: Create invitations, assign a Role, or revoke an active Role.
founderAccess.inviteBody: Create a secure 72-hour invitation for a new staff member.
founderAccess.roleBody: The change is applied to one exact user identifier.
founderAccess.accepted: The command was accepted and recorded.
founderAccess.failed: The command was not completed. Check authority and input.

travelRequest.intro: Tell us where and when you want to travel. Save an exact draft, then submit it for AI preparation and accountable human review.
travelRequest.signInTitle: Sign in to create your request
travelRequest.signInBody: A verified Customer session is required before VOYARA AI stores travel details.
travelRequest.roleDenied: This verified account does not have an active Customer role.
travelRequest.formBody: Complete the launch-critical details. Every save creates a new immutable content version.
travelRequest.notesPlaceholder: Hotels, flights, accessibility, dietary needs or other useful context
travelRequest.accuracy: I confirm that the details I supplied are accurate.
travelRequest.dataProcessing: I acknowledge that VOYARA AI will process these details to prepare this request and place it into human review.
travelRequest.dataNotice: Submitting this request does not create a Proposal, charge, Payment, Booking or Voucher.
travelRequest.saved: The exact draft version was saved.
travelRequest.submitted: Your exact request version was submitted for preparation and human review.
travelRequest.failed: The request was not saved. Check the details and try again.
travelRequest.confirmationRequired: Both confirmations are required before submission.
travelRequest.noRecent: No Travel Request has been stored for this account yet.

travelRequestStaff.queueBody: AAL2-authorised staff can read submitted requests, claim one exact request and advance only the permitted preparation states.
travelRequestStaff.humanControlNote: AI preparation does not approve commercial terms and cannot create a Proposal, Payment, Booking or Voucher.
travelRequestStaff.noRequests: No submitted Travel Request is waiting in this queue.
travelRequestStaff.accepted: The lifecycle command was accepted and recorded.
travelRequestStaff.failed: The command was denied or could not be completed. Refresh the queue.

administration.title: CRM and configuration controls
administration.intro: Coordinate operational work, read the derived Customer journey, and maintain bounded launch configuration without changing domain authority.
administration.previewBoundary: This session cannot create authoritative records. Approved prices remain visible; operational controls are disabled.
administration.pipelineBody: Stages are read from exact Travel Request, commercial, Payment and Booking records. A CRM label never overrides those records.
administration.pipelineEmpty: No persisted Travel Request is available in the derived pipeline.
administration.tasksBody: Tasks bind to one exact Travel Request version and provide ownership, due dates and immutable state history.
administration.tasksEmpty: No CRM task has been created.
administration.membershipBody: Read-only, versioned Founder-approved launch prices. Price changes require a separately authorised future control.
administration.noBenefits: No unapproved Membership benefits, rewards, fees or cancellation terms are stored or displayed.
administration.suppliersBody: Store bounded operational contact configuration with immutable versions. This registry does not contact or book a Supplier.
administration.noCredentials: Never enter passwords, API keys, bank data or Customer personal data here.
administration.supplierReadOnly: Supplier configuration changes require Manager, Admin or Founder authority.
administration.suppliersEmpty: No Supplier configuration has been created.
administration.governanceBody: Unavailable or policy-blocked controls are explicit; the interface does not simulate them.
administration.rolesBody: Role assignments remain Founder-only in the existing AAL2 access console.
administration.limitsBody: No Founder-approved threshold matrix exists. Founder-only commercial Approval v1 remains active.
administration.refundsBody: Refund request, Approval and execution remain blocked until legal/commercial cancellation and Refund terms are approved.
administration.boundary: CRM tasks and Supplier configuration cannot approve terms, verify or allocate Payment, create or verify a Booking, issue a Voucher, execute a Refund, change Roles or change Approval limits.
administration.invalid: Check the required fields and exact version data.
administration.failed: The command was denied or could not be completed. Refresh the authoritative view.
administration.accepted: The human command was accepted and recorded.

commercialStaff.queueBody: Prepare Customer terms from an assigned Travel Request, bind each version to SHA-256, and move only the exact version through human Approval and publication.
commercialStaff.authorityNote: Founder-only AAL2 Approval and publication are the safe launch default. Viewing, drafting and AI preparation never approve commercial terms.
commercialStaff.empty: No assigned Travel Request is ready for commercial review.
commercialStaff.draftOwnerOnly: Only the assigned operator can create or revise this quotation. The Founder may review and decide after submission.
commercialStaff.createBody: Enter Customer-visible terms and internal economics. Saving creates a new version; it does not approve or publish it.
commercialStaff.title: Proposal title
commercialStaff.aiBoundary: This is a human-authored MVP quotation. AI-provider drafting remains unintegrated and cannot approve, publish or accept content.
commercialStaff.founderOnly: This exact version is waiting for an AAL2 Founder decision.
commercialStaff.accepted: The command was accepted and recorded.
commercialStaff.failed: The command was denied or could not be completed.

proposalLive.intro: Review the exact published Proposal. Viewing does not create Customer Acceptance; Acceptance requires a separate explicit confirmation tied to this version and hash.
proposalLive.empty: No published Proposal is available for this account yet.
proposalLive.viewingBoundary: Viewing this Proposal is not Acceptance, Payment, Booking, Booking Verification or Voucher issue.
proposalLive.acceptBody: Confirm only if you accept the published content, total, validity and SHA-256-bound version shown above.
proposalLive.confirmExact: I accept this exact published Proposal version and total.
proposalLive.failed: Acceptance was denied or could not be recorded.
proposalLive.acceptedRecord: Acceptance is immutable and was recorded at
proposalLive.expired: This Proposal has expired and cannot be accepted. Request an updated version.

paymentCustomer.intro: Follow Payment request, evidence, human Finance Verification, allocation and financial readiness as separate authoritative states.
paymentCustomer.empty: No Payment request is available for this account yet. An accepted Proposal does not create a Payment request automatically.
paymentCustomer.boundary: A receipt, bank reference or provider event is evidence only. It is not verified Payment, allocated funds, a Booking, Booking Verification or a Voucher.
paymentCustomer.evidenceBody: Use the exact transfer or card reference. Submission places the evidence in the Finance queue and does not verify the Payment.
paymentCustomer.declaration: I confirm this evidence is accurate and understand that Finance must verify it separately.
paymentCustomer.accepted: The evidence was recorded. It remains unverified until human Finance review.
paymentCustomer.failed: The evidence was denied or could not be recorded.
paymentCustomer.readyBody: The exact accepted quotation has a human-verified Payment and a complete internal allocation.
paymentCustomer.notBooking: This status authorises the next Booking workflow only. It is not a Supplier booking, Booking Verification or Voucher.

paymentStaff.intro: Create an exact Payment request, review one evidence version, verify it as an accountable human, allocate verified funds, then evaluate financial readiness.
paymentStaff.queueBody: Accepted quotations appear here without being treated as paid. Every transition produces immutable evidence.
paymentStaff.authorityNote: Provider detection and Customer evidence remain unverified until an AAL2 Finance, Admin or Founder decision. Allocation and readiness require Finance or Founder authority.
paymentStaff.empty: No accepted quotation is waiting in the Finance queue.
paymentStaff.declaration: I confirm this is an observed event only and not Payment Verification.
paymentStaff.restricted: This next action requires an AAL2 Finance or Founder Role.
paymentStaff.boundary: READY_FOR_BOOKING does not create a Booking, contact a Supplier, verify a Booking or issue a Voucher.
paymentStaff.accepted: The command was accepted and recorded.
paymentStaff.failed: The command was denied or could not be completed.

bookingCustomer.intro: Track Booking creation, Supplier execution, Supplier Confirmation, human Booking Verification and private Voucher delivery as separate states.
bookingCustomer.empty: No Booking has been created for this account. Financial readiness does not create a Booking automatically.
bookingCustomer.boundary: The Trip Room shows only this Customer's Booking progress and the exact issued Voucher version. Internal Supplier records, rejection reasons and draft Vouchers remain private.
bookingCustomer.waitingBody: VOYARA operations must complete the next accountable Supplier step. No unconfirmed itinerary or document is presented as final.
bookingCustomer.confirmedBody: Supplier Confirmation evidence has been recorded for the exact Booking.
bookingCustomer.notVerified: Supplier Confirmation is not human Booking Verification. No Voucher can be issued until Verification succeeds.
bookingCustomer.rejectedBody: The earlier Supplier evidence is not changed. VOYARA operations must append new correction evidence and return the Booking to human review.
bookingCustomer.verifiedBody: The exact Booking, Supplier execution and Supplier Confirmation were verified by a separate accountable human.
bookingCustomer.voucherPreparing: No Voucher has been issued yet. Draft documents are not visible to the Customer.
bookingCustomer.privateDelivery: This Voucher was delivered inside the private Trip Room and is visible only to your account and authorised VOYARA staff.

bookingStaff.intro: Create a Booking from exact financial readiness, preserve Supplier evidence, perform separate human Verification, and issue only an exact Voucher version from a verified Booking.
bookingStaff.queueBody: Financially ready accepted quotations appear here. Each step is separate, exact-hash-bound and attributable.
bookingStaff.authorityNote: Only AAL2 Staff, Manager, Admin or Founder Roles may act. No command contacts a Supplier automatically.
bookingStaff.empty: No financially ready quotation is waiting in the Booking queue.
bookingStaff.financiallyReady: Exact Acceptance and financial readiness recorded
bookingStaff.executionDeclaration: I confirm that I personally completed this Supplier action and that this record does not claim Supplier Confirmation.
bookingStaff.confirmationDeclaration: I confirm that this evidence accurately reflects the Supplier response and understand that Booking Verification is a separate human control.
bookingStaff.verificationBody: Verification applies only to the exact Booking, Supplier execution and current Supplier Confirmation hashes.
bookingStaff.independentVerifierRequired: Verification must be performed by a Manager, Admin or Founder who did not execute the Supplier action or capture its Confirmation.
bookingStaff.checkCustomer: Customer details match the accepted proposal
bookingStaff.checkServices: Dates and services match Supplier Confirmation
bookingStaff.checkTerms: Price and terms match the governed Booking
bookingStaff.verificationDeclaration: I confirm that this decision applies only to the displayed exact evidence and is a separate human decision from Supplier Confirmation.
bookingStaff.correctionBody: Rejected evidence cannot be edited. This form creates a new immutable version bound to the earlier Confirmation and rejection decision.
bookingStaff.correctionDeclaration: I confirm that this new Supplier evidence accurately reflects the correction and does not alter the previous evidence.
bookingStaff.voucherBody: A draft is bound to verified Booking evidence and remains hidden from the Customer until a separately authorised human issues it.
bookingStaff.voucherDeclaration: I confirm that the Voucher content matches the exact verified Booking and Supplier Confirmation.
bookingStaff.draftNotVisible: This exact draft is not Customer-visible and carries no Voucher authority.
bookingStaff.issuedVoucher: This exact Voucher version has been issued to the Customer's private Trip Room.
bookingStaff.boundary: Supplier Confirmation is not Booking Verification. Only a separate human Verification creates verified Booking authority; only a separate human command issues one exact Voucher version.
bookingStaff.accepted: The command was accepted and recorded.
bookingStaff.failed: The command was denied or could not be completed.

supportCustomer.title: VOYARA Support case
supportCustomer.intro: Open a Support request for the exact issued Voucher and follow Customer-safe status updates.
supportCustomer.boundary: A Support case does not change Payment, Booking or Voucher authority. Cancellation, compensation and Refunds require separate authorised human decisions.
supportCustomer.openBody: The request will be bound to this Booking's exact issued Voucher version.
supportCustomer.subject: Subject
supportCustomer.declaration: I confirm the information is accurate and understand this request does not automatically create a cancellation, compensation or Refund.
supportCustomer.activeLimit: This Booking already has an active Support case. Add new information to that case.
supportCustomer.empty: No Support case has been opened for this Voucher.
supportCustomer.accepted: The Support update was accepted and recorded in the history.
supportCustomer.failed: The Support update was not accepted. Please try again.

supportStaff.intro: Claim, prioritise and manage Customer cases bound to exact issued Vouchers with an immutable event history.
supportStaff.queueBody: Separate Customer-visible updates from internal notes and attribute every action to an accountable human.
supportStaff.authorityNote: Only AAL2 Staff, Manager, Admin and Founder Roles may act. AI cannot resolve a case, promise compensation or change financial authority.
supportStaff.empty: There are no cases in the Support queue.
supportStaff.resolveDeclaration: I confirm this resolution does not change Payment, Booking, Voucher, cancellation, compensation or Refund authority.
supportStaff.closeDeclaration: I confirm closing this case does not change financial or Booking authority.
supportStaff.boundary: A Support action never verifies Payment, allocates funds, verifies Supplier Booking, issues a Voucher or executes a Refund.
supportStaff.accepted: The command was accepted and recorded in history.
supportStaff.failed: The command was denied or did not complete.

financial.body: Cash, revenue, Gross Booking Value, Gross Profit, receivables and exposure never substitute for one another.
